Interface Server

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface Server extends AutoCloseable
A running server. Closing it drains: it stops accepting connections, lets requests in flight finish for up to ServerConfig.shutdownGrace(), then stops. 
try (Server server = backend.start(ServerConfig.fromEnvironment(), app)) {
    server.await();
}
